name: Lange's-thorn
desc: Lange's-thorn (Crataegus intricata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 5 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Crataegus intricata is a species of hawthorn known by the common names Copenhagen hawthorn, Lange's thorn and thicket hawthorn. It is native to eastern Canada and the eastern United States.
